The '''Dellalt system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the planet [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]].

==History==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a ship from an Imperial convoy passing through the Dellalt system, named the ''[[Bixby]]'' [[Battle in the Dellalt system|defected]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Its crew informed the Alliance of [[Operation Strike Fear]].<ref name="XWOSG">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref> Pilot [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] later [[Mission in the Dellalt system|spotted]] an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fleet gathering in this system during a reconnaissance mission.<ref name="X-wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref> Later, the Dellalt system was the site of a [[Battle of Dellalt (Galactic Civil War)|skirmish]] between [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] forces led by the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Formidable (Victory-class)/Legends|''Formidable'']] and four squadrons of Rebel [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] and [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] starfighters, including the famed [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="XWvTF">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]''</ref>
